title: Simulation-Driven Vehicular Traffic Data Augmentation: Extending Sensor Coverage Through Virtual Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2608.13993v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Urban traffic management relies on sensor networks whose spatial coverage is limited by deployment costs and privacy regulations. Machine learning models trained on such sparse data cannot generalize to unmonitored locations and must be retrained whenever the sensor infrastructure changes. We propose a simulation-based methodology that addresses this problem by generating augmented traffic count datasets in which each physical sensor is replaced by a virtual sensor placed at a surrogate location in the road network. Virtual sensors are selected by a graph-search heuristic that jointly maximises vehicle-flow continuity and traffic-metric similarity between the original and surrogate locations, while enforcing a minimum spatial displacement to ensure diversity of observed traffic conditions. translated_title: 基于仿真驱动的车辆交通数据增强：通过虚拟感知扩展传感器覆盖范围
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13993v1 公告类型：新 摘要：城市交通管理依赖于传感器网络，其空间覆盖范围受部署成本和隐私法规限制。在这种稀疏数据上训练的机器学习模型无法泛化到未监测的位置，并且每当传感器基础设施变化时都需要重新训练。我们提出一种基于仿真的方法来解决这个问题，通过生成增强的交通计数数据集，其中每个物理传感器被放置在道路网络中替代位置的虚拟传感器所替代。虚拟传感器通过图搜索启发式算法选择，该算法在原始位置和替代位置之间联合最大化车流连续性和交通指标相似性，同时强制最小空间位移以确保观察到的交通状况多样性。我们在比利时两个城市验证了该方法：布鲁塞尔使用校准模型，那慕尔使用合成模型。增强数据集保留了原始数据的分布特征，并显著提高了模型在未监测位置的泛化能力。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于仿真的虚拟传感器方法，通过图搜索算法生成增强交通数据，扩展传感器覆盖范围，提升机器学习模型在未监测位置的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simulation-based virtual sensing method that generates augmented traffic data via a graph-search heuristic, extending sensor coverage and improving model generalization to unmonitored locations.
